sentences.text: ORDER % 21.02.2023 CRL.M.A. 4661/2023 (Exemption) Exemption allowed, subject to just exceptions.
The application is disposed of accordingly.

The present petition under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeks quashing of FIR No. 392/2012 under Sections 498A/34 of the IPC, registered at P.S. Pandav Nagar, Delhi, seeking following prayers:
" It is therefore prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to quash the F.I.R. No.392/2012 U/S-498-A/406/34 I.P.C. registered at Police Station Pandav Nagar New Delhi, and proceedings arising out of the said F.I.R. , which is pending before the Hon'ble Court of Ms. Shahzadi Halima Sadia : MM, East, Karkarduma Delhi and fixed for 20-02-2023.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that during the pendency of the present petition, a compromise deed dated 06.03.2023, has been entered into between the father of the complainant/Ms. Rubina and the present petitioners.

Learned APP for the State, on advance notice, submits that the complainant in the present case, i.e.,
Ms. Rubina passed away on 16.09.2012, just after two days of registration of the present FIR.

He further states that the charges against the petitioner no. 1 and 2 have been framed under Sections 498A/34 of the IPC and under Section 304A of the IPC against petitioner no. 1 by the Sajid & Anr vs State Of Nct Of Delhi & Anr on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/7479457/
